channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: Google forces agents onto MCP rails for Workspace from Feb 1, 2027 — and Gmail's server can't send mail
item.description: From February 2027, AI agents will have to reach Gmail, Drive and Calendar through Google's MCP servers — and the Gmail server can't send mail yet, only draft and read it.

item.title: DeepMind lets AI agents control part of its compute for Gemini experiments
item.description: Google DeepMind says AI agents now run some of the experiments behind the next Gemini models, choosing what to test and managing the compute themselves.

item.title: Visa: on-chain agent payments are ~$50K a week, flat for 6-8 months
item.description: Visa's crypto lead says on-chain agent payments across x402 and MPP total about $50,000 a week and have barely grown in six to eight months — the rails exist, but the volume doesn't yet.

item.title: Telnyx AI Assistants add WhatsApp Business messaging
item.description: Telnyx now lets businesses run AI assistants on WhatsApp Business, answering messages and voice calls on the same number with shared context.

item.title: OX Security: 22% of flagged MCP servers carry prompt injection or tool poisoning
item.description: OX Security found prompt injection or tool poisoning in 22% of flagged MCP servers, and code that couldn't be independently verified in 83% of them.

item.title: PrismML Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B scores 75.6 on SWE-bench Verified in a 5.9 GB file
item.description: PrismML released Ternary Bonsai 2.5, a 27B coding model in a 5.9 GB file that scores 75.6 on SWE-bench Verified, close to its full-precision parent.

item.title: OpenAI: GPT-6 models show intrinsic protein-design ability, with lab binding on five targets
item.description: OpenAI says GPT-6.2 designed proteins that bound all five lab targets tested, with 35 of 322 candidates showing binding in partner lab tests.

item.title: Anthropic moved its Messages API from Python to Rust, with Claude writing the new code
item.description: Anthropic moved its Messages API from Python to Rust with Claude writing the new code, cutting CPU use per request by about 70%.

item.title: OpenAI fixes GPT-6.2 billing bug — ChatGPT users hit limits up to 40% faster
item.description: OpenAI fixed a billing error that had undercounted GPT-6.2 usage, so ChatGPT users now reach their limits up to 40% faster on Astra.
